body:
One of the ugliest voices in the New Hampshire State House, Rep. Travis Corcoran (R), took a swing at me because I told my story of being the kid of immigrants, helped deport a war criminal, but am fighting against the horrors of Trump’s ICE goons.
Who is Rep. Corcoran? He is a notorious merchant of hate. He had his guns taken away after he endorsed the shooting of Congresswoman Gabby Gifford in 2011, he proudly calls for white people to use the n-word, throws around homophobic slurs, and recently called for a jewish lawmaker to face the “final solution.” And when I got death threats by the far right, he cheered that on.
He can come at me all he wants.
I can take it.
I’m not going anywhere.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1]
The person I had deported was the far-right murderer of Victor Jara.
Victor Jara, was a beloved folk singer murdered by the fascist Pinochet regime. For Chileans he is what Bruce Springsteen is to Americans.
Because of his reputation as an advocate for poor Chileans and for social justice, when the Pinochet government took control in a violent coup in 1973, Jara was abducted, tortured in front of a packed soccer stadium, executed, and his body was publicly displayed as an example.
In the mid 2000s Victor Jara’s wife hired my law firm pro-bono to bring his murderer to justice. As one of the firm's only Spanish speaking lawyers I spent a year traveling to Chile tracking down leads and conducting interviews.
Ultimately we uncovered the identity of his killer and hunted him down to the US where he had become a citizen and assumed a quiet new life (built on lies) running a pizzeria outside of Orlando, Florida.
When you become a US citizen one of the questions that you must answer is have you ever tortured anyone. In court, we were able to prove he had lied about this in his naturalization process, in turn we were able to have him stripped of his citizenship and deported back to Chile to face justice for war crimes. Now he is facing justice in Chile, and should spend the rest of his life in a Chilean jail cell.
So to respond to Travis: I am proud of what I did, war criminals should absolutely be held to account and if they came here under false pretenses, they should be deported. Hardworking immigrants like my parents and the millions presently targeted by ICE (which should be dismantled) should be left to pursue the American dream.
My background and the threat I pose to MAGA (I am poised to ensure open seat NH-01 stays blue) have put a massive target on my back — the NRCC has been attacking me since day one, Nazis stormed a rally of mine, and last month leaders of New Hampshire’s far-right called for my public hanging.
We’re rolling with the punches but we need your support to keep fighting. Please can you rush a donation of $25, $10, or even just $5 to ensure a progressive fighter takes this critical seat? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1]
DONATE TODAY!>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1]
Thank you in advance for your support at this inflection point for our campaign.
Christian Urrutia
Democrat for NH-01

“ This is not about how fast California counts ballots ,” Becker said. “ All that [Trump] cares about is whether he wins or loses. And if he loses, he’ll create a fiction in his head to tell him otherwise .”

The lies went into overdrive as the counting of California's mail ballots caused a progressive Democrat to overtake Republican former reality TV star Spencer Pratt to make the November runoff race for Los Angeles mayor.
“ The Dumocrats, right before our very eyes, are stealing the Vote ,” Trump posted in response on social media. Vice President JD Vance, House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-La.), and numerous other GOP leaders have likewise raised suspicion about the count without any proof of wrongdoing or concrete examples of problems.
This won't just bring up problems with the mail-in ballots themselves, but could also lead to a flood of post-election litigation, as opponents of voting rights, alleging fraud or the potential for it, pull out the stops to get votes thrown out and to contest results.
We have to step up and stop this election denialism and subversion before it gains a foothold. Our fundamental right to vote depends on it.

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. clean_body: | This pair is on their third set of soles, and I still wear them because it reminds me why I'm here. From me being a rookie patrol officer to being in the halls of Congress, that part of my routine hasn't changed. These boots followed me on patrol in Colorado, getting vicious gang members off the street. Now, I wear them in Congress, fighting for the victims of dangerous sanctuary state policies and having the backs of the brave men and women in blue. I served my community as a police officer for over 10 years - and I've firsthand witnessed what happens when the badge becomes the target. During the 'Defund the Police' movement in 2020-2021, Colorado Democrats turned their backs on law enforcement and empowered criminals to run the city. It came with lethal consequences. I buried one of my brothers in blue after he was assassinated by a radicalized 'Defund the Police' lunatic. I remember his locker was only five away from mine. My cop boots remind me to never surrender to the radical Democrats' anti-law and order, anti-cop, and pro-criminal agenda. I've seen how Democrats' sanctuary city policies flood peaceful communities with transnational gangs, cartels, and drug traffickers. Democrats are so focused on appeasing their Liberal mega-donors that they've destroyed families, communities, and safety. That's why my first action after being sworn in as a member of Congress in 2024 was to vote to pass the Laken Riley Act. Here's the big problem: National Democrats are already investing MILLIONS against me to flip this seat and replace me with a pro-crime, anti-cop Liberal. We won this seat by less than 2,500 votes in 2024, so I really need a rush of support to hold the line. | | Thank you for your support, Congressman Gabe Evans I've dedicated my entire life to service. From flying Black Hawk helicopters in the Middle East to serving my community as a police officer. I have and always will put serving my country and community first. Now, I'm battling Democrats in my home state of Colorado to keep this battleground seat red! This race was one of the most expensive House races in 2024 - and I won by just a couple of thousand votes. I'm grateful to Hemet's law enforcement, who was able to find the killer and arrest him.

Nicholas serves as a daily reminder to me to never take a single precious moment for granted and that I must continue to fight every single day for a better future.

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life 's mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he's determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe's entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

Friend, We all deserve safe, accessible, and affordable drinking water: Water is life and we cannot live without it. But millions of our neighbors across the country can’t afford rising water bills and are facing water shutoffs. This is because over the last five years, water rates have risen by more than 24%. In Congress, I helped create and fund the Low-Income Household Water Assistance Program (LIHWAP)—which provided $1.1 billion to help families access clean, affordable water. But as funding for that first-of-its-kind program ran out, Congress failed to fund it. That’s why, in response, Congresswoman Debbie Dingell and I have introduced the **_Water Access and Affordability Act_** , which establishes a new Low-Income Drinking Water Assistance Program at the EPA, funded at $20 billion per year. The average cost of water in Detroit has increased by at least 285% since the 1980s. And the EPA’s 2024 Water Affordability Needs Assessment estimates that between 12 and 19 million households lack affordable access to water—that’s up to 15% of American households! **Too many of our communities are struggling to afford increasingly expensive water bills.** That’s why we need the _Water Access and Affordability Act_ , to establish a permanent Low-income Drinking Water Assistance Program to help income-eligible households pay outstanding water and wastewater bills, avoid water disconnection, and assist with reconnection fees if service has been disconnected. ****[**Add your name as a grassroots co-sponsor of my new _Water Access and Affordability Act_ today to ensure every family has the resources they need to live with ****
When Congresswoman Debbie Dingell and I helped establish the Low-Income Household Water Assistance Program (LIHWAP) in 2021, it prevented 923,583 water shutoffs, restored service to 101,687 homes, and helped reduce 1,120,417 water bills.
My whole career, I’ve worked with environmental justice advocates in my hometown of Detroit, including water warriors fighting back against water shutoffs. I promise to continue fighting for our right to clean water and air.
In Congress, I’ve passed historic amendments to provide as much as $22.5 billion to fully replace dangerous lead pipes, and successfully worked with federal agencies to protect drinking water from toxic chemicals.
I also founded and am leading the Get the Lead Out Caucus, and I just co-launched the new People’s Environmental Justice Caucus—where my colleagues and I will center frontline communities most harmed by environmental injustice, and push for policies to protect people and our planet.
****[**Water is a human right and I need your help to demand Congress act to ensure no household goes without access to clean, affordable drinking water. Thank you for taking action for our fundamental rights.
We’ll keep building movements and political power to shift our government’s priorities so we protect and invest in communities—rather than corporate profits.
With you in the fight for better,
Rashida

That’s why we need the Water Access and Affordability Act , to establish a permanent Low-income Drinking Water Assistance Program to help income-eligible households pay outstanding water and wastewater bills, avoid water disconnection, and assist with reconnection fees if service has been disconnected. ** | When Congresswoman Debbie Dingell and I helped establish the Low-Income Household Water Assistance Program (LIHWAP) in 2021, it prevented 923,583 water shutoffs, restored service to 101,687 homes, and helped reduce 1,120,417 water bills. My whole career, I’ve worked with environmental justice advocates in my hometown of Detroit, including water warriors fighting back against water shutoffs. I promise to continue fighting for our right to clean water and air. In Congress, I’ve passed historic amendments to provide as much as $22.5 billion to fully replace dangerous lead pipes, and successfully worked with federal agencies to protect drinking water from toxic chemicals. I also founded and am leading the Get the Lead Out Caucus, and I just co-launched the new People’s Environmental Justice Caucus—where my colleagues and I will center frontline communities most harmed by environmental injustice, and push for policies to protect people and our planet. Thank you for taking action for our fundamental rights. We’ll keep building movements and political power to shift our government’s priorities so we protect and invest in communities—rather than corporate profits. name: Dan Osborn
subject: Why I was fired
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/113269?t=6&akid=25393%2E878179%2E4haobp) In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.

I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we needed diapers and health insurance for our growing family.

Working at Kellogg’s used to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that let you become a homeowner, live decently, and hopefully retire some day.

But over the years, that changed. Workers were paid less. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans were gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.

**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/113269?t=7&akid=25393%2E878179%2E4haobp) Most of us had never walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines through the dead of the winter if we had to. We were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.

After 11 weeks in the cold, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying union jobs.

It was one of the proudest moments of my life. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/113269?t=8&akid=25393%2E878179%2E4haobp) Following the strike, I was fired. Someone had to pay – and as union president, my head was on the chopping block.

It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.

Instead, I decided last year to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and we nearly won. I got 47% of the vote in one of the closest Senate races in the country.

**Now, I’m running again for the U.S. Senate – this time against billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts – and the first poll shows us virtually TIED: 46% to 45%.**

I am taking on a literal billionaire senator. We can finish what we started last year and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat for working class people, but I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this seat.

[Please, will you contribute to my campaign for U.S. Senate and the Voter Protection Project to help me defeat billionaire Republican Pete Ricketts here and flip Nebraska’s Senate seat? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/113269?t=9&akid=25393%2E878179%2E4haobp) If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Dan Osborn and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/113270?t=10&akid=25393%2E878179%2E4haobp)

name: Stacy Garrity
subject: There's a place for you in this campaign
body:
Join one of our campaign coalitions to help us build a winning team across Pennsylvania.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | Peter,

One of the things I've learned from traveling to all 67 counties every year is that Pennsylvania's strength comes from its people.
Every community has unique concerns. Every family has a different story. And every Pennsylvanian has something valuable to contribute.
That's why we're building coalitions across the Commonwealth to ensure that people from every walk of life have a voice in this campaign.
---
| [JOIN A COALITION](https://us.list-manage.com/BGXGsI6zFkY?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd&i=96a0ea8fe1)
---
| | | | | |
Whether you're a veteran, a small business owner, a farmer, a parent, a sportsman, a member of law enforcement, or simply someone who wants a better future for Pennsylvania, there is a place for you on Team Garrity.
Our coalitions help us:• Connect supporters with shared interests and experiences• Share important campaign updates and opportunities• Recruit volunteers and community leaders• Amplify our message throughout Pennsylvania• Ensure our campaign reflects the people we hope to serve
This campaign won't be won from a headquarters in Harrisburg.
It will be won by Pennsylvanians in communities across all 67 counties who are willing to step up and get involved.
That's where you come in.
I hope you'll take a moment today to join one or more of our campaign coalitions and help us build the grassroots movement that will carry us to victory in November.
---

# Powell to the People
---
| | | |
## Campaign Update
Nate Powell Received 3 New Endorsements
* Last week, 3 additional unions endorsed Nate:
* SEIU 775, which represents more than 60,000 long-term care workers providing quality care for seniors
* United Association of Plumbers and Pipefitters (UA), representing a wide variety of piping trades including plumbers, steamfitters, HVACR technicians, welders and pipeliners
* The Sailors' Union of the Pacific (SUP), a union representing mariners and deck department workers on U.S.-flag vessels
* This week, Nate has a busy town hall schedule, continuing to meet with voters to hear their concerns.
* On Monday he was in Dayton, talking to voters of Columbia County
* Tuesday took him to Clarkston in Asotin County

## US and Iran Sign Iran War Deal
President Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian [electronically signed the 14-point agreement](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1ygzAQhU8DnRj9IlyoSEPntCkZgRbYWEiMJJtxTp9RrpB2d2ff-76v-3S36DFsn_YAU9Y4Bbiyh1IgTZhscGB9xi2Ay8_jgLTE-IgTp7wntCdsmJxF_55k68wKwEG0YJgemNZasaHdzTxoDkqAcpZSLhnIm7N61rPqpRCzbdHUb7RnA6OMqb4TbuVMcw2zmoWTt0ZScFhi6r4jhrLD6t_xBalb4tF6s5dy5kZ8NHxs-HhdVxfmpVLUfZ3E5F3Dx0rT8DGXZLGQPabj-UMSxBMCeWbicS2k3pBsw1IwhkyYJGeNJNUCyQAPDBuB4EhaghWKKibaZNx5ofeYe91Iuh0W_V-18i-fL8N_AwAA__9G_ouf) to end the war on Wednesday, with Trump inking his copy at the Palace of Versailles over dinner with French President Emmanuel Macron. The deal reopens the Strait of Hormuz, lifts sanctions, and ends the naval blockade, while Iran [commits not to develop](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O3CAUhZ8Gd3cE2AZvQZHG3aZNaYG5nrkJPxbg2fjtI_IK25zmSJ_Od359bp-WAqXnTxvRtCNvCb9qwNawbFRs8mhDpWdCX68Ysew5_8mb5FIBVyCWzVsK9zYN3hyIEscBjdCL0FrPYhlexglp1eQsn7XXTku38w9nuRNeTUJpNZDpNK7EIrgQs3qM_pBCS41udqOfPtjE0VPL5fE7U2ovPMKd31gee45DMK_WzsrGH0yuTK7pPnNtvWJy7WAmV95DaCbXq0L3Y3LdczwDNgQxwdmxcFXownCi3RG6NxyUbAg3FHyjDejB3dDKFU-wPlKi2optlBMUtB4a_m1ACY4rBCbXoRh_flEIVJVmE39GS-H_5vato99G_gsAAP__hQmS7Q) nuclear weapons and to dilute its enriched uranium under international supervision. Both sides have [60 days to reach](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O4yAUxfGngc4RXGywC4pt3GXbLS1sru27w0cEJFHefuR5hamP9Jd-5999uTsKlI6_LqJte14SvmvA1rAsVFzy6EKlI6GvzxixbDl_5QUE6E7oTo6LdxQ-S8-93REBFUcrzSiNMYMc-Wndtq6j08oIDZsUwkwOwBvlvAAzGc3JXjWh5SiFlIO-Kb-DNGBwHVbl-4n1Aj21XG7_M6V24h4--YXltuXIgz1be1Sm_jCYGcztxJNCuDYG85kjXiAGs_OREtVWXKOcGMzDBJMadNfKMz66y1i7S9y5oyBGTI3BzIv1jzeFQFUb1osjOvqJ8_art14WvgMAAP__xQ5-mA) a final deal. Trump said the deadline isn't hard as long as Iran cooperates, but warned he'd resume bombing if it doesn't. The full text was released yesterday. [Read the key points here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u3CAQBeCnwR0WjH_ABUUad5s2pYVh7CXhZwV4nX37K-4r3G6kkc7Rd_48tod23sXztw6o6pG2iHfxWCvmzWUdLWpf3BnRlisEzCalf2kDBjNlM-Vys9r5zzZ2Vh2IgEOHigvJhRATl91TmZkPYOQo9oFNRsIihmkCYfaFgVjk1DnV0tjMJWecT3M_2AO4AIH7tA92XMjI0Lqacv83uVifePhPemPuTQqdV89aX4UMvwisBNb7vnuzl6ZofwJrOwmsV6HNQxuIBgyp4a5A00GvaDGXqqN18aQV_1cCa5eVfd3Oe1dmQUZ2Bu38d2X90U5vBV8BAAD__61FfPc).
## DC's Reflecting Pool Turns Green
National Park Service crews spent Tuesday [pouring hydrogen peroxide](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAURb8GM7vgoaIBwSZmvemGFspT3g7wLGS6p_9-qucXJr5V99Q5_-7L3VGkfPx1CW3decn4vCLWimWh4rJHFy86MvrrMyUsG_MHLyBhaOXQqnHxjuJr6Rpvd0RA3aBVZlTGmF6NTbASVxh7o9SEe4fbaFZw2yp1r70xYKaG7PtNDmpUUql-uGm_gzJgcO1X7btJdBI9VS63_0y5Btzjix9YbhunJtpQ63kJ_UfALGCuAQPF-N4EzIETvoUEzM4nynTV4ipxFjD3EwzaQBtevvCBuT2x8Bd5bAvuEbdK-WhP5ihgbor155NipGswopNHcvTDaOqvoj0sfAcAAP__rn-BtQ) into the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool after an algae bloom turned President Trump's promised "American flag blue" renovation bright green. The bloom appeared days after a [$14.2 million project](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQhZ8Gd7Zg_AMpKLZxl223tDAMzuyOwcIkVt5-lXsf4dbn6Oh835_7cnfElLbfbkdbY14SXidjrVgWKi4FdHzSljCcz33H4nP-lxeQMLVyapVZgiN-L0MTbEQE7Bu0ShultR6VaR429jA5vN2GwYwSxgAy9Mrp6IMzq4SpIftZk5MySio1Tl0fIigNGtdx7cNwE4PEQDWX7m-mVB8Y-Z1fWDqf94bto9bjFP0vAbOA-bquLq3-Q_HJBcxHZqrkTwFzyMlxaGt57oeAuWBk9JXS1h45c7sVxNQ63hx-d9rik-tHCdo0xYbjImY6Jy0Gue2O-OtB_ZG2l4X_AQAA___qgIKy) to resurface the pool for the nation's 250th birthday. ## Laredo Jet Crash Kills Austin Startup Founder
A NetJets business jet carrying six people crashed onto Laredo's Loop 20 and burst into flames late Tuesday, killing [Austin tech entrepreneur Joshua Baer](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD3SozAQRE8jMlHS8B8o2ITMm25IDcxg5JURJY2Nffste4_wxd3V1e_9uUwX9MHv1994ZyevNU47nzmwCKcpYGKKN5YlYd4kxcMvGLLECQy02rTa9hOhD--pLsjNhgZbsLNdb7veNAMUm2ttR_U6LENDZOaZFuq6piaCemgIBii8-4yZ1vbWmsra0rJFriw31FiaK1S1YfISUykbC78wr-Edn5zKJd6L4DaRI6vql4JRwXieZ_n3hfsnVDB-aBSMIS4YFIz4yOJ3BeMt5u2BekZO-hppRdk46bjq_42ss2CSx6Hzwjtr8py13_URcGf91aFgLJKj4_Qh-Nx2qjbXO_rwfSU_c_l08C8AAP__Wo2Lxw) and leaving five survivors. The Cessna Citation Latitude had left San Jose del Cabo, Mexico, bound for Austin before reporting mechanical trouble near Laredo International Airport, authorities said. The impact nearly sheared the jet in half and tore off its tail. As traffic stopped, drivers left their cars and ran toward the burning wreckage. [Bystander video captured by a passing motorist](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OgzAQhJ8GOiLv2hi7cHFNulx7JVrwEnxyYmRW-Xn7E3mFK0ejmdE3P5fxQimn-_WbbhzktZTxzs89swjXMVPlWH5Z5kr7KrVsaaa8SxlRoe2U7cCNkVJ-j6aNYVLRQ8sBBgeDU73Hdg3g3cALW-sGxIHUxDZ6hcZPEwAY16ZwlCkLDkBpgBMwEGvgPvYQJ02NURyTlHqSlYVftC_5XR5cT3O5tTmsItve6K8Gzw2eaTsADusQVdKcucHzJ9dtme7cfWg6H4En0_OsZ2McLqgt8qxJe-s1OWxriNsz5Zx2OzRGXW-U8mdS_nfUI-BfAAAA___9FXsr) showed people striking the cockpit glass with a sledgehammer and using a shovel to pry the door open and pull survivors free. A motorist whose car was struck and five police officers were hospitalized. ## Texas Hosts Two World Cup Openers
Texas hosted [two World Cup openers](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD0TmzAMhn8NbOZs85nBQ5ds6dqRE7YAtwribCUk_74HU_duOkn33Pu8vx7jAyLFbfkJT3TymXnc8MiEIphGgoSBf6P4BHmVxHv0QFl4tNp2SnfKDGOASN-xKYObdLiZEp3pB9MPur3ZcnVd5xH6YfD9hDDD1DXBT0MAa-vW1PZWRnfCdGcGY3RtTGXQANYG29CaMNVQNBpDFE6VrCj4gTzTl9-YKs_Pktwqsuei_lHYe2Hvx3FUM3-aU-N8OFecKCj_2v-d1aUg8AezOmHqIivhAF-1c5LXAqTeWXneFlYhqZVfWXhTuC0EW7huiUEiqABEkMvkwn5Eopi7vmj08oRIV0j5v2rfzv4NAAD__2Wvkjo) on Wednesday. England beat Croatia 4-2 at Arlington's AT&T Stadium, while Cristiano Ronaldo's Portugal drew 1-1 with DR Congo in Houston. Harry Kane [scored twice in Arlington](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OgzAQxfHTmM7INp8pXGxDl223RAMewCvDWPYEktuvkits_9PT0__nPt7BB3-s37Cj5edC44FXDsiMaQyQ0NEv8pwgb5wo-hlCZhqNMq1UrdT96MCH11gXzk7K3XSBVne97nrV3Eyx2aWGmzNTU02u72tV49KDxs6g6drJYFt4-x5Tre61VpXWpUYNWGlsXKPdVIGoFTrPlErekPEJeQkvOjGVM-1FsBtzzKL6EmYQZriuq1zomSMlzm8hzBD8iXIKtAozZJpnTMIMeKwBDifPLOdEwB7kxz2iA8Ys80wJJVOUMcAryyXRLtdEjyiDzBtdjq6jSNbFy4fgc9uJWq07-PD5xf-reVrzFwAA__8fQY3S)--a retaken penalty and a header--to match Gary Lineker as England's record World Cup scorer, before Jude Bellingham and Marcus Rashford put the game away. The win marked a successful World Cup debut for England manager Thomas Tuchel. In Houston, Joao Neves headed Portugal ahead early, but DR Congo's Yoane Wissa equalized in [first-half stoppage time](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ygzAQhJ8GOjE68WNcqEhD57QpmYM7QBmBGOls2W-fcSZvkGqb3Z1vvq_beEPn3bF-4s5WnksYD87JswjH0WNkCt8sc8S0SQynm9EnCaPRplO6U9CPhM6_xqYkO2m6QskWLj1cet1eTbnZiVrCpW5BXyeERi9NT03TGmiROtBT6ez7THfQA-gaoAIG5Bq4pRZoqrFoNJOTECvZWPiJafGv8OBYzWEvvd1EzlTUH4UZCjPknKslPE23hXuScLxLhRnSGaKkwgzvvK_oFUU1h2MNanELqhyiJzXfT7WjzJv6Wys-KClQoChiLqOlMzvvXeouRaPXHZ3_pZD_uXtY8xMAAP__rnaF7A) for the nation's first-ever World Cup goal, in its first appearance since 1974. Ronaldo, in a record sixth World Cup, played all 90 minutes without a shot on target before 68,777 fans at NRG Stadium. The split openers began a busy stretch for Texas, which hosts World Cup matches in Arlington and Houston into late June.
